title: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 on B200, vLLM v0.31: TP=4 aggregated (4 GPUs) and 1P1D disaggregated (8 GPUs); no-router vs llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified vs turn-priority, with and without 387 GiB CPU offload
description: Step 26. One vLLM pod per point (4 B200, TP=4, MTP 3, FP8 KV, GPU KV 4.74M to 4.84M tokens, max-num-seqs 2x concurrency), AgentX replay of the Weka Claude Code trace, 60 min per point, KV cache reset per point. CPU tier 387 GiB = 12.68M tokens (measured: 5,959 chunks of one 2128-token attention block; Qwen3.5 keeps KV in 15 of 60 layers). llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified (llm-d-router main): capacity = the server's vLLM kv_cache_size_tokens, lease 10 s, forced admission 1800 s.  Step 30 adds llm-d-router v1.0.0 turn-priority (3 points). Step 33 adds 1P1D prefill/decode disaggregation (5 points, c=32 to 128): one prefill and one decode server, TP=4 each on one 8x B200 node, KV over NIXL/RDMA, MultiConnector NIXL + 387 GiB CPU offload on each server (CPU tier 2 x 12.68M tokens), vllm-project/vllm#62862 fix on, vLLM's NIXL toy proxy (every request P then D), no router. Per-GPU metrics divide by 8 GPUs; compare at equal concurrency per GPU (1P1D c=64 against TP=4 c=32). Step 34 adds llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified on the 1P1D pair (3 points, c=64, 96, 128): EPP built from zetxqx/llm-d-router#15 (thunder-agent tracks only decode pods under P/D), capacityTokens = the prefill server's GPU KV pool (4,843,063), lease 10 s, forced admission 1800 s, always-disagg through the llm-d disagg sidecar. Past the knee it keeps the pair near its c=64 point (343 to 355 output tok/s/GPU) where the no-thunder 1P1D collapses (287 at c=96, 75 at c=128). Step 26 part 2 adds TP=4 without the CPU tier (no --kv-offloading-size), no-router vs llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified (same settings, capacity = each server's kv_cache_size_tokens) at c = 24, 32, 48, 64, 96 (10 points, 2026-10-28). A third CPU-off arm, llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified with utilThreshold 0.8 (gate capacity 80% of the GPU KV pool), adds 5 points at c = 24 to 96 (2026-10-29). Knee points c = 28, 36, 40, 44 for all three CPU-off arms add 12 points (2026-10-29). A gate capacity sweep, llm-d-thunder-agent-simplified at utilThreshold 0.7 and 0.6, adds 10 points at c = 24 to 40 (2026-10-29).
